mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of RSAFS and HOUST and 20-day forward returns is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) or the interaction effect is absent in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (indicated by a 5% month-over-month decline in industrial production), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines by more than 5% MoM, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 2%, it signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS falls below its 12-month MA by more than 2%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS and 5-day forward returns is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) or the interaction effect is absent in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 3-month moving average by more than 1%, it signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below its 3-month MA by more than 1%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window).
